description: Song-specific factual questions about jazz standards that ARE covered in detail in the RAG corpus (frontend/data/explanation/standards/*.txt). Designed to test whether RAG helps when the corpus actually contains the answer — vs. the abstract-theory questions in Task B where the corpus has no direct coverage. Model answers JSON {"answer":"..."}; scored by normalized match against accept[].
